Find Researchers / Potential Supervisors

Jiayu Chen · Mathematics

Home · Resources

A source-linked starting directory, not a complete faculty database. Search fine topics and common aliases; compare programme rules before deciding whether to contact someone.

1195 source-linked researchers across 18 countries/territories. Latest roster expansion: 2026-10-12; individual review dates are shown below. Mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics and mathematical physics are included; a department listing does not establish supervision eligibility. 3 researchers have qualifying public student events; no individual current student vacancy is confirmed in this batch. These counts mean different things. Availability must be checked directly, without automated or bulk emails. 869 records include explicitly published professional emails and a source; missing emails are not guessed. 882 have published topic evidence; 42 have group membership only; 271 have no verified research-topic field. These are not interchangeable.
